description: Where points on the laid survey map are in the garden, in metres — e.g. the plot's corners read off the map, for set_boundary. Points are given on any view of the laid map's image (see zoom_image).

view.description: The image or close-up the point is on: "1" (image 1 as you see it), "1.2" (a close-up)

x.description: Pixels from the left of that view

y.description: Pixels from the top of that view

name: map_to_garden
